summary.body:
This is a comment-only change to `last_n` and matches its stated intent (no behaviour change). I checked the claim against the actual slicing semantics: for any `n` greater than `len(items)`, `-n` is more negative than `-len(items)`, so Python clamps the slice start to index 0 and `items[-n:]` does return the whole list, exactly as the new comment states. The code itself is untouched, so there's no behavioural risk introduced by this diff.

Approving — the documentation is accurate for the case it describes.
